checks.instruction: On a real browser with the real managed Remotion Studio, confirm that the primary presentation Studio opens the whole variant/master composition and feels like one normal Remotion project rather than a single-slide project.
checks.prerequisite: The user restarts their own Jarvis (Core + Control Center) on branch task/jarvis-remotion-master-project-studio-export themselves; no agent starts, restarts or stops it. No migration and no new environment variable in this task. The Remotion capability must be `ready` (card « Présentations · moteur »).
evidence: slices/05-remotion-studio-master-project/evidence/ (studio-master-open.png, studio-master-scene2.png, studio-master-scene3.png, studio-master-summary.json: real remotion studio on a 3-scene master, variant switch, unpublished-edit refusal, back to a scene target)

slices/09-release-and-human-acceptance/evidence/studio-master.png and release-studio-summary.json (4 scenes 1920x1080 @ 30 opened from Variants in ~35 s; JarvisPresentation, <Series>, the audio track; scenes 1-4 seen by stepping; unpublished edits set aside only after discard; Core outage)

checklist.step: Pick (or ask Jarvis for) a Remotion presentation whose scenes share one size and frame rate (a new Jarvis deck is 1920x1080 @ 30). Open it in Variants; under the video the line reads « Vidéo entière : « titre », variante n, N scènes (durée). ». Click « Remotion Studio », read the dialog (« N scènes vont tourner hors du bac à sable, dans Remotion Studio »), confirm.
checklist.look_at: The dialog names the whole video, not one scene; a counter runs while Studio starts (30-90 s cold); the line then says « Remotion Studio est ouvert sur la vidéo entière (N scènes) » or offers the tab link.

checklist.step: In the Remotion Studio tab: the composition list holds one `JarvisPresentation`; play it or drag the playhead across the whole timeline; open the file tree.
checklist.look_at: One timeline whose duration is the sum of the scenes; a <Series> with one sequence per scene, in variant order, each scene starting at its own beginning; media tracks (audio/video) where your scenes have them; `src/scenes/<scene>/` per scene and generated `studio-root.tsx` / `src/master/` (read-only). Does it feel like one normal Remotion project?

checklist.step: Optional: edit a scene file in Remotion Studio, then in Variants click « Remotion Studio » on another variant (or « Actualiser » after a voice edit).
checklist.look_at: Jarvis refuses to rebuild while the edit is unpublished and names the file; confirming sets it aside in `<data root>/local_capabilities/remotion/studio-edits/<timestamp>/` (never overwritten, never published). To keep a scene edit: « Cette scène seule dans Remotion Studio », then « Publier dans la variante… ».
